# Bobine Official APT Repository (apt.bobine.fit)

> Official cryptographically signed Debian/Ubuntu APT repository for Bobine (https://bobine.fit) — the free, open-source (AGPL-3.0) video playout and streaming system for sports clubs and fitness studios.

## Overview
- **Repository Host**: https://apt.bobine.fit
- **Supported Architectures**: amd64 (x86-64)
- **Supported Operating Systems**: Debian 12 (Bookworm), Debian 13 (Trixie), Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (Jammy), Ubuntu 24.04 LTS (Noble), Linux Mint 21/22
- **Cryptographic Signature**: RSA 4096-bit GPG key
- **Key Fingerprint**: 941B 6F52 6A72 59F4 694C F4BC 1B5D 18A9 76FA AD15
- **Key Identity**: Bobine APT Repository <contact@bobine.fit>
- **Public Key Location**: https://apt.bobine.fit/bobine.gpg

## Installation Instructions

### 1. Import Official GPG Keyring
Import the public key into the standard system keyrings directory:
```bash
curl -fsSL https://apt.bobine.fit/bobine.gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/bobine.gpg
```

### 2. Configure Repository Source
Add the signed APT source definition:

**Stable Channel (Recommended for production playout):**
```bash
echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/bobine.gpg] https://apt.bobine.fit/ stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/bobine.list
```

**Beta Channel (Rolling pre-release channel):**
```bash
echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/bobine.gpg] https://apt.bobine.fit/ beta main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/bobine.list
```

### 3. Install or Upgrade Bobine
```bash
sudo apt update && sudo apt install bobine
```

## Features of the Debian Package (.deb)
- **Automatic Updates**: Handled via standard `sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade`.
- **AppStream Metadata**: Certified for Ubuntu App Center and GNOME Software with AGPL-3.0 licensing.
- **Desktop Integration**: Includes `.desktop` launcher, system notification area icon (systray), and standard XDG configuration (`~/.local/share/bobine/`).
- **Hardware Acceleration**: VA-API hardware decoding for Intel (QuickSync / iHD) and AMD (mesa-va-drivers) at <8% CPU utilization for 1080p60 and 4K streams.
